title: Geant4 simulation code and datasets for Ti3C2O2 MXene / PPS gamma-ray shielding composites

creators.name: Suresh, Sidharth
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat, India

creators.name: Vineeth, Bobba
creators.affiliation: Department of Physics, Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat, India

description: Two-phase Geant4 Monte Carlo study of oxygen-terminated Ti3C2O2 MXene in a polyphenylene sulphide matrix, benchmarked against Pb, W, BaSO4 and Bi2O3 fillers across six gamma energies, five thicknesses and six filler loadings. Contains the Geant4 applications for both phases, the run drivers, the analysis scripts, the figure scripts and the full master datasets.
